rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses (incl. audio and video presentations) from a Board-approved sponsor; clinical dentistry/dental hygiene or nonclinical subjects supporting clinical care (patient management, legal and ethical responsibilities, stress management)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first renewal after initial licensure.
rules.carryover: Extra hours may be credited to the next renewal year, max 15 hours.
rules.alternatives: Up to 3 h for uncompensated care to low-income patients via a local health department or free clinic. Exemption (disability, military, disasters) or up to 1-year extension on written request before renewal.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit after the renewal period; keep original records 4 years after renewal.
rules.notes: Annual renewal in the birth month (18VAC60-21-240). Current hands-on CPR or BLS required (ACLS/PALS where sedation rules require). Sedation/GA providers and monitors: 4 h every 2 years on sedation/anesthesia, counted in the 15. No business, marketing or financial planning courses.

topics.who: Current hands-on CPR or BLS (ACLS/PALS where sedation rules require)
